writtenAt: 2026-10-11 (before evaluation; the API side probed that day, the web shop and the admin area not looked at, so the pages may hold defects this key doesn't list)
format: a loose product-owner story, no numbered criteria, web shop and API together; the checks need data five levels deep: category, sub-category under it, brand, product under both, then the shop's search, filters and product page, then a cart line

defects.description: the catalogue is not protected: a visitor who is not signed in and a customer can create brands, categories and products (201) and change them (PUT 200); only deleting is refused (401 for a visitor, 403 for a customer)
creating a product under a brand that does not exist answers 500 "Something went wrong" instead of a refusal that says what is wrong

traps: data dependencies: a product can't be removed while it is in a cart, nor a brand or category while a product uses it, so cleanup must run in reverse order (cart, product, sub-category, category, brand)
the tests that show D1 create records without an administrator: those records must be removed with the administrator's token
a cart accepts more than the stock (8 of 7): no criterion covers that, so it is not a finding
records the tests create are visible to everyone on the shared demo while a run lasts
